BAPC-problems.json.verification_notes: Problems of the main contest, numbered as in the contest (A = 1, B = 2, …). Each statement is transcribed from the official English problem set published on the BAPC site of the year and checked against its page images. The problem sets are © the BAPC juries and licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); these transcriptions are shared under the same licence. Statements only: no solutions or test data.

BOI-problems.json.verification_notes: Competition tasks of both days, numbered per day as in the contest. Each statement is transcribed from the official English statements of the day as kept in the BOI archive (boi.cses.fi) and checked section by section (input/output format, constraints, subtasks, sample tests, figures) against its page images. Statements only: no solutions or test data; the sample tests printed in the statement stay.

CCC-problems.json.verification_notes: Problems of the Junior (Day 1 in the bank) and Senior (Day 2) papers, numbered J1–J5 and S1–S5 as in the contest. Each statement is transcribed from the English part of the official problem booklet published by the Centre for Education in Mathematics and Computing (CEMC), University of Waterloo, and checked against its page images. CEMC materials are licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International (https://cemc.uwaterloo.ca/copyright); source: CEMC, University of Waterloo. Statements only: no solutions or test data.

COCI-problems.json.verification_notes: Tasks of every round of the season (the year is the start of the season: 2025 = 2025/2026), numbered per round as in the round's task list. Each statement is transcribed from the official English task booklet of the round in the COCI archive (hsin.hr/coci) and checked section by section against its page images. Statements only: no solutions or test data; the sample tests printed in the statement stay.

ECNA-problems.json.verification_notes: Problems of the regional contest, numbered as in the contest (A = 1, B = 2, …); the year is the season start. Each statement is transcribed from the official English problem set in the regional archive (icpc-ecna.ysu.edu/PastResults) and checked against its page images. Statements only: no solutions or test data.

JOI-problems.json.verification_notes: Tasks of the Final Round (Honsen), numbered as in the contest; the year is the year of the contest (2025 = JOI 2024/2025). Each statement is transcribed from the official English translation published by the Japanese Committee for the IOI (ioi-jp.org) and checked section by section against its page images; time and memory limits from the official limits file of the round. Statements only: no solutions, reviews or test data; the sample tests printed in the statement stay.

Each statement is transcribed from the official English statement on the contest site (contests.ioi-jp.org) and checked section by section against its page images. Statements only: no reviews, solutions or test data; the sample tests printed in the statement stay.

PACNW-problems.json.verification_notes: Problems of the Division 1 contest, numbered as in the contest (A = 1, B = 2, …); the year is the season start (2022 = the regional held in spring 2023). USACO-problems.json.verification_notes: Tasks of every contest of the season in each division (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum; the year is the start of the season: 2024 = 2024/2025), numbered as in the contest; each contest and division is one paper. Each statement is transcribed from the official English problem page on usaco.org and checked line by line against it; figures are the images of the official page. Time and memory limits are the USACO defaults (2 seconds for C/C++, 256 MB) unless the statement states others. Statements only: no analyses, solutions or test data; the sample tests printed in the statement stay.
